judgments.reason: The span 'Triglyceride level: 8.44 mmol/L (747 mg/dL)' appears literally in the vignette and a markedly elevated pleural fluid triglyceride level is the diagnostic criterion for chylothorax, supporting the chylothorax component of the label.
The span 'Mix of small to large B lymphocytes' appears literally in the vignette as a pathological finding from lymph node biopsy, directly supporting a lymphoma etiology for the chylothorax.
The span 'Aberrant expression of BCL2' appears literally in the vignette as a pathological finding, supporting a B-cell lymphoma diagnosis as the etiology of the chylothorax.
The span 'Elevated Ki-67' appears literally in the vignette as a pathological finding indicating high proliferative activity consistent with lymphoma, supporting the lymphoma etiology modifier.
